def place_keep(obj, x, y, z, yaw=0.0):
    T = mathutils.Matrix.Translation((x, y, z))

    L = obj.matrix_world.copy()
    obj.matrix_world = T @ R @ L

import bpy, mathutils
from math import tan, radians

def make_cam(name, pos, look, up):
    cam_data = bpy.data.cameras.new(name)
    cam_data.lens = 18.0 / tan(radians(39.6/2))  # 36mm sensor, fov_x=39.6
    cam_data.sensor_width = 36
    o = bpy.data.objects.new(name, cam_data)
    bpy.context.collection.objects.link(o)
    f = mathutils.Vector(look).normalized()
    u = mathutils.Vector(up).normalized()
    r = f.cross(u).normalized()
    u2 = r.cross(f).normalized()
    M = mathutils.Matrix(((r.x, u2.x, -f.x, 0),
                          (r.y, u2.y, -f.y, 0),
                          (r.z, u2.z, -f.z, 0),
                          (0, 0, 0, 1)))
    o.matrix_world = mathutils.Matrix.Translation(pos) @ M
    return o
